title: Semistability at a marked curve point
statement: Let $P=(X,D,i)$ be an underlying pair over a scheme $T$ [def-trf-semistable-multipointed-pair]. For an open subscheme $U\subseteq X$, its restriction is the pair $(U,D\times_X U,i_U)$ over $T$, where the marking and inclusion are the categorical pullback [def-pc-fibre-product] of $i:D\to X$ along $U\to X$ in the category of schemes over $T$. For $x\in X$, define $P$ to be semistable at $x$ if there exists an open neighbourhood $U$ of $x$ for which this restricted pair is semistable [def-trf-semistable-multipointed-pair], including its marking.
